_doc: PostgreSQL Metadata subsystem dependency map. Importance score is in [0.0, 1.0]; higher means more central to the metadata story (catalog data model, catalog modification API, cache stack, SLRU, VM, FSM, persistence). Categories follow the 15 sections of the request brief. Depth-from-entry is measured from the conceptual entry points (CatalogTupleInsert, RelationIdGetRelation, SearchSysCache1, CreateCheckPoint, StartupXLOG, RecordTransactionCommit, visibilitymap_set, fsm_search). All file:line references are from this PostgreSQL source tree.

ControlFileData.overview: Cluster control file struct in pg_control. Anchors recovery: system_identifier, state, checkPoint, redo, nextXid, oldestXid, nextMulti, nextMultiOffset, oldestMulti, oldestCommitTsXid, newestCommitTsXid, wal_level, plus parameter settings. Updated atomically via UpdateControlFile.

CheckPoint.overview: Body of a CheckPoint XLOG record carrying redo, ThisTimeLineID, fullPageWrites, wal_level, nextXid, nextOid, nextMulti, nextMultiOffset, oldestXid, oldestMulti, oldestCommitTsXid, newestCommitTsXid, oldestActiveXid. A copy is stashed in pg_control for disaster recovery.

CreateCheckPoint.overview: Top-level checkpoint driver. Computes redo pointer, drains WAL insertion locks, calls CheckPointGuts to flush per-subsystem dirty state, writes XLOG_CHECKPOINT_ONLINE/SHUTDOWN, and updates pg_control via UpdateControlFile.

CheckPointGuts.overview: Inner checkpoint dispatcher; in order: CheckPointRelationMap, CheckPointReplicationSlots, CheckPointSnapBuild, CheckPointLogicalRewriteHeap, CheckPointReplicationOrigin, CheckPointCLOG, CheckPointCommitTs, CheckPointSUBTRANS, CheckPointMultiXact, CheckPointPredicate, CheckPointBuffers, ProcessSyncRequests, CheckPointTwoPhase. The single integration point that flushes every metadata subsystem.

StartupXLOG.overview: Startup-process main entry point: reads pg_control, finds redo pointer, sets XID/Multi/CommitTs cursors, invokes StartupCLOG/SUBTRANS/MultiXact/CommitTs, replays WAL via xlog_redo dispatch, runs Trim* and reaches consistent state.

ReadControlFile.overview: Reads pg_control at startup, validates magic+CRC, checks pg_control_version + catalog_version_no compatibility, and copies fields into shared XLogCtl.

UpdateControlFile.overview: Recomputes CRC and atomically writes ControlFileData back to pg_control. Called every checkpoint and during state transitions.

WriteControlFile.overview: Bootstrap-only initial writer of pg_control, called once per cluster.

RecordTransactionCommit.overview: Builds an xl_xact_commit record (sub-XIDs, dropped relfilenodes, invalidation messages, timestamp), inserts XLOG_XACT_COMMIT, then updates CLOG via TransactionIdCommitTree. The single point where a transaction's metadata effects (catalog mutations, dropped storage, cache invalidations) become durable.

TransactionIdCommitTree.overview: Records the entire transaction tree (top + sub-XIDs) as committed in CLOG. Calls TransactionIdSetTreeStatus with TRANSACTION_STATUS_COMMITTED. Invoked both at primary commit and during xact_redo_commit on standbys.

TransactionIdAbortTree.overview: Records the entire transaction tree as aborted in CLOG. Called from RecordTransactionAbort and xact_redo_abort.

xact_redo_commit.overview: Redo callback for XLOG_XACT_COMMIT. Calls TransactionIdCommitTree (CLOG), ProcessCommittedInvalidationMessages (sinval broadcast), and smgrDoPendingDeletes. The standby learns about catalog changes here.

xact_redo.overview: Top-level rmgr redo dispatch for RM_XACT_ID. Branches on XLOG_XACT_COMMIT/ABORT/PREPARE/COMMIT_PREPARED/ABORT_PREPARED/INVALIDATIONS.

GetNewTransactionId.overview: Allocates the next XID, extends CLOG/SUBTRANS/CommitTs as needed, registers the XID in PGPROC. Triggers ExtendCLOG/ExtendSUBTRANS/ExtendCommitTs and emits XLOG_CLOG_ZEROPAGE / COMMIT_TS_ZEROPAGE if a fresh page is needed.

GetNewObjectId.overview: Allocates the next OID, emits XLOG_NEXTOID every VAR_OID_PREFETCH OIDs to advance ShmemVariableCache->nextOid durably across crashes.

heap_create_with_catalog.overview: End-to-end relation creator: inserts pg_class + pg_attribute + pg_type rows, calls heap_create to set up storage (RelationCreateStorage), records dependencies, fires object_access_hook. Entry point for CREATE TABLE.

heap_create.overview: Constructs a Relation descriptor and creates the relfilenode storage via RelationCreateStorage; does NOT insert pg_class/pg_attribute rows.

heap_drop_with_catalog.overview: Drops a relation: removes pg_class, pg_attribute, pg_index/related catalog rows; calls RelationDropStorage to schedule pending unlink at commit; removes dependency rows.

AddNewRelationTuple.overview: Inserts the pg_class row for a new relation. Centralizes setting reltype, relam, relfilenode, etc.

AddNewAttributeTuples.overview: Inserts pg_attribute rows for every column of a relation, plus all six system columns.

InsertPgClassTuple.overview: Builds a Form_pg_class tuple from a Relation and inserts/updates it in pg_class via CatalogTupleInsert/Update.

DeleteRelationTuple.overview: Removes a row from pg_class for a dropped relation.

RelationRemoveInheritance.overview: Deletes pg_inherits rows where the relation is a child.

CheckAttributeType.overview: Recursive type-validity check used during relation/attribute creation.

index_create.overview: Creates an index relation: pg_class row, pg_attribute rows, pg_index row, dependency rows, builds storage, optionally builds the index. Heart of CREATE INDEX, REINDEX, and bootstrap.

index_drop.overview: Drops an index: removes pg_index/pg_class rows, deletes pg_attribute rows, drops storage. Has a concurrent path that splits the work across transactions.

index_constraint_create.overview: Creates the matching pg_constraint row for a unique/primary-key/exclusion index.

index_update_stats.overview: Updates pg_class.relpages/reltuples/relallvisible after VACUUM or index build. Uses systable_inplace_update_finish for locked, atomic update without bumping xmin.

ReindexRelationConcurrently.overview: Builds a new index alongside the old one, swaps via index_concurrently_swap, then drops the old.

CatalogTupleInsert.overview: Sanctioned catalog mutator: heap_insert + CatalogIndexInsert. Keeps heap and every system index of the catalog in sync. Plain heap_insert is forbidden in catalog code.

CatalogTupleInsertWithInfo.overview: Faster variant when caller already opened the indexes via CatalogOpenIndexes.

CatalogTuplesMultiInsertWithInfo.overview: Bulk insert variant using TupleTableSlot to amortize index updates.

CatalogTupleUpdate.overview: Sanctioned update: heap_update + CatalogIndexInsert. Bumps xmin like a normal MVCC update.

CatalogTupleDelete.overview: Sanctioned delete: simple_heap_delete (which goes through heap_delete). Indexes are NOT updated here because btree leaves dead pointers that vacuum cleans up.

CatalogIndexInsert.overview: Inserts an index entry into every index of a system catalog.

CatalogOpenIndexes.overview: Opens every index on a catalog and prepares an ExecState-style structure for repeated insertions (CatalogIndexState).

CatalogCloseIndexes.overview: Closes the indexes opened by CatalogOpenIndexes.

recordDependencyOn.overview: Inserts a single pg_depend row. The basis of all object-graph tracking.

recordSharedDependencyOn.overview: Records a pg_shdepend row for cross-database object references (e.g., owner role).

deleteDependencyRecordsFor.overview: Removes pg_depend rows for a soon-to-be-dropped object.

performDeletion.overview: Top-level recursive object dropper: builds the dependency closure via findDependentObjects, reports it, and calls deleteOneObject for each.

performMultipleDeletions.overview: Performs deletion of multiple objects with a shared dependency closure (for ordered DROP).

findDependentObjects.overview: Recursively walks pg_depend to compute the full set of objects that depend on a target.

AcquireDeletionLock.overview: Takes a strong lock on a soon-to-be-dropped object so a second backend cannot use or drop it concurrently.

ReleaseDeletionLock.overview: Symmetric release of the lock taken by AcquireDeletionLock.

doDeletion.overview: Switches on classId and dispatches to the per-class dropper (RemoveRelations, RemoveFunctionById, RemoveAttrDefaultById, ...).

DropObjectById.overview: Drops one object given its ObjectAddress; thin wrapper around doDeletion.

RangeVarGetRelid.overview: Resolve a RangeVar (schema-qualified name) to an Oid, with locking and search-path semantics. The single most-used name resolution function.

RangeVarGetCreationNamespace.overview: Decides which schema a CREATE statement should target (search_path or explicit qualifier).

LookupExplicitNamespace.overview: Resolves a schema name to its Oid with permission checks.

recomputeNamespacePath.overview: Rebuilds the cached active search_path list when search_path GUC changes or sinval invalidates the cache.

RelationCreateStorage.overview: Creates the on-disk file for a new relfilenode and emits XLOG_SMGR_CREATE. Records a pending-delete entry so abort can unlink the file.

RelationDropStorage.overview: Schedules a relfilenode unlink at commit time. Adds a PendingRelDelete entry; the actual unlink happens in smgrDoPendingDeletes after WAL emit.

log_smgrcreate.overview: Builds and inserts XLOG_SMGR_CREATE so the standby/recovery creates the same file.

smgrDoPendingDeletes.overview: On commit, performs all queued unlink() calls; on abort, undoes the create-storage path. Called by CommitTransaction and xact_redo_commit.

smgrDoPendingSyncs.overview: On commit (under wal_level=minimal), fsyncs the new relfilenodes that skipped WAL.

RelationTruncate.overview: Truncates a relation's storage and emits XLOG_SMGR_TRUNCATE.

smgr_redo.overview: Redo callback for RM_SMGR_ID. Replays XLOG_SMGR_CREATE and XLOG_SMGR_TRUNCATE.

NewHeapCreateToastTable.overview: Adds a TOAST table to a relation that exceeds the inline-tuple size threshold; creates the toast heap, its index, and links pg_class.reltoastrelid.

ExecGrantStmt_oids.overview: Per-object workhorse for GRANT/REVOKE; updates aclitem arrays in the catalog row via CatalogTupleUpdate.

get_object_address.overview: Resolves a parsed ObjectType + name list to an ObjectAddress (classId, objectId, objectSubId). The frontdoor for DDL.

RunObjectPostCreateHook.overview: Fires object_access_hook with OAT_POST_CREATE for an object just created. Used by sepgsql, pg_audit.

RunObjectDropHook.overview: Fires object_access_hook with OAT_DROP. Symmetric to RunObjectPostCreateHook.

RelationGetPartitionDesc.overview: Builds (and caches in partcache) the PartitionDesc for a partitioned table from pg_inherits and pg_class.

RelationData.overview: The relcache entry struct (rd_*). Caches a Relation's pg_class form, TupleDesc, RelFileLocator, indexes, AM routines, RowSecurityDesc, etc. The runtime view of a table or index.

RelationIdGetRelation.overview: Returns a reference-counted Relation for the given Oid: looks up RelIdCacheHash; if miss, calls RelationBuildDesc to construct it.

RelationClose.overview: Decrements the relation refcount and may free the Relation if zombie.

RelationBuildDesc.overview: Builds a RelationData from scratch: ScanPgRelation, AllocateRelationDesc, RelationBuildTupleDesc, RelationBuildRuleLock, RelationInitPhysicalAddr, RelationInitTableAccessMethod / RelationInitIndexAccessInfo. Inserts into RelIdCacheHash.

RelationInitTableAccessMethod.overview: Resolves pg_am.amhandler -> TableAmRoutine and stores it in rd_tableam.

RelationCacheInitialize.overview: Phase-1 relcache init: sets up RelIdCacheHash. Called extremely early in backend start.

RelationCacheInitializePhase2.overview: Phase-2: nails the four shared catalogs (pg_database, pg_authid, pg_auth_members, pg_shseclabel, pg_subscription) via formrdesc, before pg_class is reachable.

RelationCacheInitializePhase3.overview: Phase-3: nails pg_class, pg_attribute, pg_proc, pg_type via formrdesc, then loads or builds the per-database pg_internal.init relcache file.

formrdesc.overview: Creates a hardcoded relcache entry for a 'nailed' catalog (pg_class, pg_attribute, pg_proc, pg_type, plus the shared variants) using the BKI schema macros embedded in the header. Bootstraps the relcache before the relcache itself is usable.

load_critical_index.overview: Bootstraps the index that backs a nailed catalog (e.g. ClassOidIndexId for pg_class), so the relcache can scan pg_class to build other relations.

RelationClearRelation.overview: Invalidates a Relation: either rebuilds in place (rebuild=true, used after CCI) or destroys it (rebuild=false, on full sinval). Handles the live-pointer problem by careful rd_isnailed/rd_refcnt logic.

RelationFlushRelation.overview: If the Relation has no live references, destroy it immediately; otherwise mark it for rebuild on next access.

RelationCacheInvalidate.overview: Invalidates ALL relcache entries (sinval reset). Walks the hash table and calls RelationClearRelation.

write_relcache_init_file.overview: Serializes the current relcache contents (pg_class + pg_attribute + pg_index for nailed and a few hot catalogs) to pg_internal.init. Subsequent backends skip the catalog scan.

load_relcache_init_file.overview: Symmetric reader; produces relcache entries directly from pg_internal.init without any catalog access.

RelationCacheInitFileRemove.overview: Deletes pg_internal.init at server start so the first backend rebuilds it. Triggered when starting from a non-clean state.

RelationCacheInitFilePostInvalidate.overview: Releases the lock taken before deleting the init file (the matching post-invalidate companion to PreInvalidate).

RelationSetNewRelfilenumber.overview: VACUUM FULL / CLUSTER / TRUNCATE helper: assigns a new RelFileNumber to a relation and updates pg_class (or pg_filenode.map for mapped catalogs).

RelidByRelfilenumber.overview: Reverse mapping RelFileNumber -> Oid via a per-database hash, built lazily by scanning pg_class. Used by WAL replay tools and pg_buffercache.

CatCache.overview: Per-syscache hash-table-of-CatCTup struct: cc_relisshared, cc_indexoid, cc_keyno, cc_hashfunc, cc_fastequal, cc_lists. Holds tuple-level cache for one (relation, key) pair.

CatCList.overview: Cached result of a partial-key search (e.g. all rows of pg_proc with proname=X). Backs SearchSysCacheList.

InitCatCache.overview: Constructs a CatCache (without contacting the catalog yet); installs hash equality fast paths.

CatalogCacheInitializeCache.overview: Lazily completes a CatCache: opens its catalog, fetches the TupleDesc, resolves the underlying index. Called on first lookup.

SearchCatCacheInternal.overview: Hot path of all syscache lookups: hash key, walk bucket list, on hit increment refcount and return. On miss calls SearchCatCacheMiss to scan the catalog index.

SearchCatCacheList.overview: Multi-row search (partial keys); returns a CatCList that the caller iterates. Used by FuncnameGetCandidates and similar.

CatCacheRemoveCList.overview: Drops a CatCList and decrements refs on its members.

CatCacheRemoveCTup.overview: Drops a CatCTup; takes care of removing it from the bucket and releasing its tuple.

CatCacheInvalidate.overview: Flushes all entries of a CatCache that match a given hashValue; called by sinval message processing.

ResetCatalogCaches.overview: Wipes every CatCache (for SI_RESET); used when sinval queue overflows.

PrepareToInvalidateCacheTuple.overview: For a given (catalog, oldtuple, newtuple), figures out which CatCaches contain affected entries and queues invalidation messages for each.

SearchSysCache1.overview: Most-used syscache front door: dispatch to the underlying CatCache via the cacheinfo[] table.

SearchSysCache2.overview: Two-key syscache lookup; e.g. SearchSysCache2(RELNAMENSP, namekey, oidkey).

ReleaseSysCache.overview: Decrements the refcount on a HeapTuple obtained from SearchSysCache.

SearchSysCacheLocked1.overview: Locked variant: fetches the row, then takes a tuple-level lock so concurrent inplace-updates cannot overwrite it.

SearchSysCacheCopy.overview: Returns a heap_copytuple of the cached row so the caller can keep it past ReleaseSysCache.

SearchSysCacheAttName.overview: Two-step lookup pg_attribute by relid + attname (uses ATTNAME).

SearchSysCacheAttNum.overview: ATTNUM lookup: pg_attribute by relid + attnum.

SysCacheGetAttr.overview: Extracts a Datum from a cached HeapTuple, using the cached TupleDesc.

SysCacheGetAttrNotNull.overview: Like SysCacheGetAttr but errors out if NULL; eliminates per-call boilerplate.

GetSysCacheOid.overview: Convenience helper that does a syscache lookup and returns the OID column.

GetSysCacheHashValue.overview: Computes the cache hash for a key tuple without doing a lookup; used by inval.c when broadcasting.

SysCacheInvalidate.overview: Wrapper around CatCacheInvalidate that takes a cacheId (SysCacheIdentifier) and dispatches to the right CatCache.

RelationInvalidatesSnapshotsOnly.overview: Returns true if changes to the given relid only invalidate snapshots, not catalog caches (e.g., pg_largeobject).

RelationHasSysCache.overview: Returns true if the relation has at least one CatCache built on it.

RelationSupportsSysCache.overview: Returns true if either the relation or one of its supporting indexes is registered in syscache.

CacheInvalidateHeapTuple.overview: Catalog-mutator hook: queues catcache + relcache + snapshot invalidations for the given (relation, old, new) tuple. Called from CatalogTupleInsert/Update/Delete.

CacheInvalidateHeapTupleByRelid.overview: Variant that takes a relid instead of a Relation pointer.

CacheInvalidateRelcache.overview: Queues a relcache invalidation for a single Relation. Used for things like rule/trigger creation.

CacheInvalidateRelcacheByRelid.overview: Variant that takes a relid; opens the relation just to read pg_class.relisshared etc.

CacheInvalidateRelcacheAll.overview: Forces every backend to throw away all relcache entries.

CacheInvalidateCatalog.overview: Invalidates every cache on a given catalog (the per-catalog cousin of CacheInvalidateRelcache).

CacheInvalidateSmgr.overview: Notifies every backend that the SMgrRelation cache for a given (db, rel) should drop its entry. Sent on TRUNCATE/UNLINK.

CacheInvalidateRelmap.overview: Notifies every backend that pg_filenode.map (for the given dbid or shared) has changed.

RegisterCatcacheInvalidation.overview: Adds a catcache-invalidation message to the per-transaction outbox.

RegisterRelcacheInvalidation.overview: Adds a relcache-invalidation message to the per-transaction outbox.

RegisterSnapshotInvalidation.overview: Adds a snapshot-invalidation message (for relations like pg_largeobject that only need snapshot resets).

PrepareInvalidationState.overview: Lazily initializes the per-transaction outbox (TransInvalidationInfo) when first invalidation is queued.

AddRelcacheInvalidationMessage.overview: Appends a single SHAREDINVALRELCACHE_ID message to the outbox group.

AddCatcacheInvalidationMessage.overview: Appends a single SHAREDINVALCATCACHE_ID message to the outbox group.

xactGetCommittedInvalidationMessages.overview: Drains the outbox into the array embedded in xl_xact_commit. The standby gets the same messages and replays them via ProcessCommittedInvalidationMessages.

ProcessCommittedInvalidationMessages.overview: Replay-time entry point: broadcasts the messages via SendSharedInvalidMessages so every backend on the standby learns about catalog changes.

AtEOXact_Inval.overview: Commit-time hook: emits messages locally + via SendSharedInvalidMessages. Abort path discards the outbox.

AtEOSubXact_Inval.overview: Subtransaction-end hook: merges the subxact outbox into the parent (commit) or discards (abort).

CommandEndInvalidationMessages.overview: Per-command hook (CCI): processes queued invalidation messages locally so subsequent commands within the same transaction see the changes.

LocalExecuteInvalidationMessage.overview: Dispatches a single SharedInvalidationMessage to the right local cache (catcache, relcache, smgr, relmap, snapshot).

AcceptInvalidationMessages.overview: Drains the per-backend sinval queue and applies messages locally. Called whenever we open a relation, take a lock, or otherwise need a current view.

InvalidateSystemCaches.overview: Wipes ALL local caches (catcache, relcache, plancache, snapshot). Used on sinval reset.

InvalidateSystemCachesExtended.overview: InvalidateSystemCaches with debug_discard support; primary target of debug_discard_caches GUC.

CacheRegisterSyscacheCallback.overview: Extension hook: register a callback to fire when a given SysCacheIdentifier is invalidated.

SendSharedInvalidMessages.overview: Pushes invalidation messages to the shared-memory ring buffer (SInvalShmem). Called at commit and during recovery replay.

ReceiveSharedInvalidMessages.overview: Drains messages from the ring buffer into a callback (LocalExecuteInvalidationMessage) and a reset callback. Detects queue overflow and triggers SI_RESET.

SIInsertDataEntries.overview: Atomically inserts N messages into the ring buffer; takes SInvalWriteLock + SInvalReadLock as needed; sets every backend's resetState if the buffer overflows.

SIGetDataEntries.overview: Reads up to datasize messages from the ring buffer into the caller's local array, advancing the per-backend cursor.

SICleanupQueue.overview: Garbage-collects fully-consumed messages from the ring buffer; if a backend lags too much, sets its resetState to force an SI_RESET.

SInvalShmemSize.overview: Reports shared-memory size for the sinval ring buffer.

CreateSharedInvalidationState.overview: Allocates and initializes the SharedInvalidStateData struct in shared memory.

SharedInvalBackendInit.overview: Per-backend init: claims a slot in the sinval ring and links it into ProcGlobal.

RelationMapOidToFilenumber.overview: Looks up the RelFileNumber for a mapped catalog (pg_class itself, etc.) in the in-memory shared/local map. Used to bootstrap RelationInitPhysicalAddr for nailed catalogs.

RelationMapUpdateMap.overview: Records a new (oid -> filenumber) mapping. Goes into pending_xxx until CCI then active_xxx; the on-disk write happens at commit via perform_relmap_update.

write_relmap_file.overview: Atomically writes a RelMapFile: build CRC, write to .tmp, fsync, rename to pg_filenode.map, fsync directory; optionally emits XLOG_RELMAP_UPDATE and sends sinval.

load_relmap_file.overview: Reads pg_filenode.map (shared or local), validates magic + CRC, copies into the in-memory map struct.

perform_relmap_update.overview: Commit-time helper: merges pending updates into the live map, writes the file (atomic + fsync), emits XLOG_RELMAP_UPDATE.

AtCCI_RelationMap.overview: Promotes pending updates to active at CCI boundary.

AtEOXact_RelationMap.overview: End-of-xact relmap finalizer: on commit, perform_relmap_update; on abort, discards pending+active.

AtPrepare_RelationMap.overview: Forbids relmap changes inside PREPARE TRANSACTION (relmap updates aren't 2PC-safe).

CheckPointRelationMap.overview: Acquires RelationMappingLock so that no relmap update is mid-flight while pg_control is being updated.

RelationMapInitializePhase2.overview: Phase-2: load the global pg_filenode.map (for shared catalogs).

relmap_redo.overview: Redo callback for RM_RELMAP_ID: replays XLOG_RELMAP_UPDATE by writing the new map file directly.

SlruCtlData.overview: Per-SLRU control struct: pointer to SlruShared in shmem, nbanks, long_segment_names flag, sync_handler, PagePrecedes callback, on-disk Dir.

SlruSharedData.overview: Shmem state for one SLRU: page_buffer[], page_status[], page_dirty[], page_number[], page_lru_count[], buffer_locks, bank_locks, group_lsn[], latest_page_number.

SimpleLruInit.overview: Init function for one SLRU instance: sets up shmem state, opens on-disk subdir, registers per-bank LWLocks and the sync handler. Called by CLOG/SUBTRANS/MultiXact/CommitTs/Notify/Serial during shmem init.

SimpleLruZeroPage.overview: Initializes a fresh SLRU page in shmem (page_status=VALID, page_dirty=true). Used by Extend* and during redo of XLOG_*_ZEROPAGE.

SimpleLruReadPage.overview: Brings a page into shmem: if a slot already holds it, return; otherwise allocate via SlruSelectLRUPage and call SlruPhysicalReadPage. Honors per-bank LWLock.

SimpleLruReadPage_ReadOnly.overview: Optimistic variant: tries with shared bank lock first; falls back to ReadPage with exclusive lock on miss.

SimpleLruWritePage.overview: Wrapper around SlruInternalWritePage that flushes one slot to disk if dirty.

SimpleLruWriteAll.overview: Checkpoint hook: flushes every dirty slot in this SLRU to disk.

SimpleLruTruncate.overview: Removes segment files older than cutoffPage; uses SlruScanDirectory + SlruInternalDeleteSegment + per-bank locks.

SlruInternalWritePage.overview: Marks a slot WRITE_IN_PROGRESS, calls SlruPhysicalWritePage, restores VALID; aware of in-progress reads.

SlruPhysicalReadPage.overview: Opens a segment file, reads BLCKSZ bytes into the slot.

SlruPhysicalWritePage.overview: Writes BLCKSZ bytes to the segment file; queues a sync request to the checkpointer.

SlruScanDirectory.overview: Iterates segment files in the SLRU directory, invoking a callback per file. Used for Truncate, BootStrap, async-pre-clean.

SlruSelectLRUPage.overview: Picks a victim slot in the same bank for replacement: first EMPTY, otherwise least-recently-used VALID slot. Writes it out if dirty.

SimpleLruGetBankLock.overview: Inline helper: returns the LWLock for the given pageno's bank (low bits of pageno mod nbanks).

SlruSyncFileTag.overview: Common sync-handler implementation: turns a FileTag into a path so the checkpointer can fsync it.

TransactionIdSetTreeStatus.overview: Atomically marks all XIDs of a transaction tree (top + sub-XIDs) with the given XidStatus in CLOG. Spreads work over multiple calls to TransactionIdSetPageStatus when the tree spans CLOG pages.

TransactionIdSetPageStatus.overview: Sets status for the XIDs that belong to one CLOG page. Uses TransactionGroupUpdateXidStatus to batch concurrent committers.

TransactionIdSetPageStatusInternal.overview: Inner page-update routine: locks the bank, sets status bits, updates async LSN if needed.

TransactionIdSetStatusBit.overview: Sets the 2 status bits for a single XID inside a CLOG page; honors LSN tracking for async commits (CLOG_LSNS_PER_PAGE).

TransactionGroupUpdateXidStatus.overview: Group-update optimization: a single backend updates many XIDs on the same page on behalf of multiple concurrent committers, reducing CLogControlLock contention.

TransactionIdGetStatus.overview: Reads the 2 status bits for an XID. Used by visibility checks (HeapTupleSatisfiesMVCC) and SubTransGetTopmostTransaction. Optionally returns the latest async-commit LSN.

ExtendCLOG.overview: Called from GetNewTransactionId: if newestXact crosses a page boundary, zero the new page and emit XLOG_CLOG_ZEROPAGE.

TruncateCLOG.overview: Called from vac_truncate_clog after vacuum advances cluster-wide oldestXid; emits XLOG_CLOG_TRUNCATE then SimpleLruTruncate.

CheckPointCLOG.overview: Checkpoint hook: SimpleLruWriteAll flushes dirty CLOG pages.

BootStrapCLOG.overview: Bootstrap: zeroes page 0 and writes it out before any transactions exist.

StartupCLOG.overview: Resets in-shmem state at recovery start; doesn't read disk yet.

TrimCLOG.overview: After redo finishes: zeroes the unused tail of the latest CLOG page so future xids start clean.

clog_redo.overview: Redo callback for RM_CLOG_ID: replays XLOG_CLOG_ZEROPAGE (SimpleLruZeroPage + SimpleLruWritePage) and XLOG_CLOG_TRUNCATE (SimpleLruTruncate).

SubTransSetParent.overview: Records the parent XID for a sub-XID. 4 bytes per XID. Called whenever a subtransaction acquires its first XID.

SubTransGetParent.overview: Reads the parent XID for a given XID; returns InvalidTransactionId for top-level.

SubTransGetTopmostTransaction.overview: Walks parent chain back to top-level XID; used in visibility checks when an XID may be a sub-XID.

ExtendSUBTRANS.overview: Zeros a fresh SUBTRANS page when a new XID needs one. Not WAL-logged (subtrans is reconstructed from runtime calls).

TruncateSUBTRANS.overview: Removes SUBTRANS segments older than oldestActiveXact.

StartupSUBTRANS.overview: Wipes SUBTRANS pages older than oldestActiveXID at recovery start. Subtrans is rebuilt by replaying live transactions.

CheckPointSUBTRANS.overview: Flushes dirty SUBTRANS pages at checkpoint.

TransactionTreeSetCommitTsData.overview: Sets commit timestamp + RepOriginId for an entire xact tree in pg_commit_ts. Emits XLOG_COMMIT_TS_SETTS in some configurations (replication origins).

TransactionIdGetCommitTsData.overview: Reads the (TimestampTz, RepOriginId) tuple for an XID. SQL-exposed via pg_xact_commit_timestamp().

GetLatestCommitTsData.overview: Returns the highest-XID commit timestamp seen on this server (used by logical replication subscriber).

ExtendCommitTs.overview: Zeros a fresh page; emits XLOG_COMMIT_TS_ZEROPAGE; only active if track_commit_timestamp=on.

TruncateCommitTs.overview: Truncate companion: emits XLOG_COMMIT_TS_TRUNCATE and SimpleLruTruncate.

ActivateCommitTs.overview: Switch-on path: reads control flags, opens the SLRU dir, populates the appropriate range based on oldestCommitTsXid/newestCommitTsXid.

StartupCommitTs.overview: Recovery init for commit_ts: load oldestCommitTsXid/newestCommitTsXid from pg_control and activate if needed.

CheckPointCommitTs.overview: Flushes dirty pg_commit_ts pages at checkpoint.

commit_ts_redo.overview: Redo callback for RM_COMMIT_TS_ID: replays ZEROPAGE / TRUNCATE / SETTS.

MultiXactIdCreate.overview: Builds a new MultiXactId from two members (typical xmax-promotion path). Calls MultiXactIdExpand if a multi already exists.

MultiXactIdExpand.overview: Adds a new member to an existing multi (or creates a new multi if the original is dead).

GetNewMultiXactId.overview: Allocates the next MultiXactId, extends both pg_multixact/offsets and pg_multixact/members as needed; emits XLOG_MULTIXACT_ZERO_OFF_PAGE / XLOG_MULTIXACT_ZERO_MEM_PAGE.

RecordNewMultiXact.overview: Writes the offset and member entries for a new multi to the SLRU; emits XLOG_MULTIXACT_CREATE_ID.

MultiXactIdGetUpdateXid.overview: Given a multi locking a tuple, finds the XID that did the update (status >= NoKeyUpdate). Used by visibility.

GetMultiXactIdMembers.overview: Returns the array of members for a multi: reads pg_multixact/offsets to find the start, then pg_multixact/members.

MultiXactIdIsRunning.overview: True if any member of the multi is still running. Optimistic check used by tuple-locking code.

TruncateMultiXact.overview: Truncates pg_multixact/offsets to newOldestMulti and pg_multixact/members based on the recorded start offset; emits XLOG_MULTIXACT_TRUNCATE_ID.

SetOffsetVacuumLimit.overview: Computes the multixact-members truncation watermark from the size of the members SLRU vs MultiXactMemberFreezeThreshold.

MultiXactAdvanceOldest.overview: Advances cluster-wide oldestMulti / oldestMultiDB after vacuum.

CheckPointMultiXact.overview: Flushes both offsets and members SLRUs at checkpoint; updates oldestMulti in pg_control via MultiXactGetCheckptMulti.

StartupMultiXact.overview: Recovery init: reads nextMulti / nextMultiOffset from pg_control and re-zeroes pages beyond.

TrimMultiXact.overview: After redo end: zero pages beyond nextMulti/nextMultiOffset.

multixact_redo.overview: Redo callback for RM_MULTIXACT_ID: replays ZERO_OFF_PAGE, ZERO_MEM_PAGE, CREATE_ID, TRUNCATE_ID.

visibilitymap_clear.overview: Clears VISIBILITYMAP_ALL_VISIBLE / ALL_FROZEN bits when the heap page is modified. Always treated as durable (LSN updated, possibly an XLOG_FPI_FOR_HINT).

visibilitymap_set.overview: Sets VISIBILITYMAP_ALL_VISIBLE / ALL_FROZEN bits with the heap page LSN as a high-water mark, ensuring VM page LSN is at least as new as the youngest tuple it claims visible. Emits XLOG_HEAP2_VISIBLE.

visibilitymap_pin.overview: Pins the VM page covering heapBlk before the heap page lock is taken (deadlock-avoidance vs vacuum).

visibilitymap_pin_ok.overview: Returns true if the currently-pinned VM buffer covers heapBlk; lets callers re-use a pin after retry.

visibilitymap_get_status.overview: Returns the 2-bit status for a heap block. Used by index-only scans (skip heap visibility check) and by vacuum (decide if scan needed).

visibilitymap_count.overview: Counts ALL_VISIBLE and ALL_FROZEN pages by scanning the entire VM. Used by vacuum and pg_visibility.

visibilitymap_prepare_truncate.overview: Computes the new VM nblocks after a heap truncate; called from RelationTruncate.

vm_readbuf.overview: Reads/pins one VM page; calls vm_extend if extend=true and the page does not yet exist.

vm_extend.overview: Extends the VM_FORKNUM relation fork by zero-filling new pages; uses smgrextend.

GetVisibilityMapPins.overview: Pre-pins the VM pages for a list of candidate heap blocks before any heap-page lock is taken; the deadlock-avoidance helper used by hio.c.

GetPageWithFreeSpace.overview: Top-level FSM lookup for an insert: returns a heap block with at least spaceNeeded bytes free, or InvalidBlockNumber.

RecordAndGetPageWithFreeSpace.overview: Records actual free space on oldPage and finds another candidate. The combined update+search used after a tuple insert.

RecordPageWithFreeSpace.overview: Updates a single FSM leaf; used by VACUUM to record post-pruning free space.

XLogRecordPageWithFreeSpace.overview: Logs a single FSM update during heap WAL replay (only used in the heap-extension path where the new page itself is WAL-logged).

FreeSpaceMapVacuum.overview: Bottom-up reconciliation of the FSM tree after vacuum. Calls fsm_vacuum_page to push leaf maxima up.

FreeSpaceMapVacuumRange.overview: Like FreeSpaceMapVacuum but only for a heap-block range. Used by parallel vacuum worker.

FreeSpaceMapPrepareTruncateRel.overview: Computes new FSM nblocks after a heap truncate and rebuilds upper-level entries.

fsm_search.overview: Top-down tree walk: at each level, fsm_search_avail picks a slot whose value >= min_cat. Restarts on stale-pointer error.

fsm_set_and_search.overview: Atomic update + next-page search inside one buffer pin; used after a tuple insert to re-record free space.

fsm_vacuum_page.overview: Recursively bubbles leaf maxima up to upper-level pages.

fsm_get_location.overview: Translates heapblk -> (FSMAddress, slot). The arithmetic at the heart of FSM addressing.

fsm_logical_to_physical.overview: Maps an FSMAddress (level + page#) to the physical block number using the closed-form formula y = n + (n/F+1)+(n/F^2+1)+...

fsm_get_parent.overview: Returns parent FSMAddress + slot of a given child.

fsm_get_child.overview: Returns child FSMAddress for a slot on a parent page.

fsm_readbuf.overview: Pins/reads an FSM page; uses RBM_ZERO_ON_ERROR to bypass checksum failures (FSM is hint-grade).

fsm_extend.overview: Extends the FSM_FORKNUM relation fork by writing zero-pages.

fsm_search_avail.overview: Per-page binary-tree walk: returns the leftmost leaf slot >= minvalue. Detects corrupted upper nodes and triggers fsm_rebuild_page.

fsm_set_avail.overview: Sets a leaf slot's category and bubbles the change up through the page-internal tree.

fsm_rebuild_page.overview: Repairs a corrupted page by recomputing all internal nodes from leaf values.

fsm_space_avail_to_cat.overview: Maps free-byte count -> 8-bit FSM category. There are 256 categories.

GetFreeIndexPage.overview: indexfsm.c entry point: returns a free index page (used by btree, gist, etc.).

RecordFreeIndexPage.overview: Records that an index page is now free (binary 0/1 categories for indexes).

IndexFreeSpaceMapVacuum.overview: Symmetric to FreeSpaceMapVacuum but for indexes.

RelationGetBufferForTuple.overview: Picks a heap page for a new tuple: GetPageWithFreeSpace then GetVisibilityMapPins. The bridge between FSM, VM, and the buffer manager.

lazy_vacuum_rel.overview: Top-level VACUUM driver: scans heap (lazy_scan_heap), prunes/freezes (heap_page_prune), records free space (RecordPageWithFreeSpace), updates VM (visibilitymap_set), removes dead index entries, calls vac_update_relstats and FreeSpaceMapVacuum.

vac_truncate_clog.overview: Cluster-wide vacuum hook: scans pg_database for the minimum datfrozenxid/datminmxid; calls TruncateCLOG, TruncateCommitTs, TruncateMultiXact, SetTransactionIdLimit.

object_access_hook.overview: Function pointer fired by RunObjectPostCreateHook / RunObjectDropHook / RunObjectPostAlterHook. The single extension point for security or audit modules.
